## Personality

Emily possesses a notable talent for dressmaking. She is recognized for her good taste and her ability to create garments with exceptionally fine fits.

## History

Emily is a classmate of Anne's at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). She works diligently alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their peers as they all prepare for their upcoming examinations.
